description: Returns pairs of passages in which a question asked in one place is answered in another (e.g. 'what is man?' in Job and Psalm 8). Each pair has its theme, the asking and answering passages, and a note. theme (god, man, suffering, sin, death, time, wisdom, worship, messiah) or contains narrows the list; unfiltered, every pair comes back in one large piece. Use when the user asks about a question in one passage that another passage answers.

contains.description: only questions whose text contains this word

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

theme.description: theme id: god, man, suffering, sin, death, time, wisdom, worship or messiah

name: list_questions
title: Questions and their answers
